Bowling King is a manga written by taiwanese comic artist Tong Ai about a kid named Shautieh Ley and the humiliation he puts himself and his opponents through in bowling alleys. This is NOT Prince of Bowling. Instead, think of this as Simpsons + Kingpin, or Great Bowler Shautieh.  
  
Shautieh is infatuated with Tz'zuhn whose family owns a bowling alley. When he finds out that Tz'zuhn's family has a $3M debt and that Tz'zuhn has an American pro bowler boyfriend, Shautieh tries to resolve everything, with bowling of course. However, although Shautieh has an incredibly strong left arm, he doesn't know anything about bowling. What now, Shautieh?

No entanto, apesar de Shautieh ter um braço esquerdo incrivelmente forte, não sabe nada sobre boliche. E agora, Shautieh?

title.en: Rebirth: The Turnabout of a Mistreated Concubine

description.en:
After traveling through time, she finds herself in Prince Xuan’s bed, and has inexplicably become his maid whom he could sleep with at will. While filling her world with whispers of love, the romantic, dissolute prince turned a blind eye to the misdeeds of several other concubines, which includes framing her for adultery, disfiguring her, as well as imposing an extreme penalty against her. When she opens her eyes again, instead of travelling through time, she is reborn as a drop-dead gorgeous lady. In possession of vast wealth and surrounded by all sorts of good-looking men, she decides that she will no longer keep her nose clean. As for that liar, Prince Xuan, should still put on a show of love and affection in front of her?

---
When she woke up, she realized that she had transmigrated into the bed of Prince Xuan and mysteriously become his bedside maid. The prince, who's an unloyal playboy, tells her that he loves her everyday, but at the same time he allows her to be mistreated. He even watches as she is accused of cheating on him and is disfigured before being drowned to death. When she awakes once more, she is back in the present with a pretty face. Having been reborn, she no longer cares for being mediocre. With delicious food and drinks in one hand, and dozens of dollar bills on her other hand, she is surrounded by beautiful men as she lives a lavish and excessive life. That is until the lying man shows up one day claiming to still be in love with her. Is he lying, or is he being honest for once?

---

The little dragon will have to face the dangers and intrigues of the royal court, while at the same time trying to get closer to the prince and discover his true feelings. description.en: Only the chosen dead person can reach this place, where killing monsters can exchange for longevity, thus extending life! Qianye, after surviving a near-death battle, finally returns to the mortal realm, only to discover that the ‘longevity’ reward comes with a time limit! Once the time limit expires, Qianye once again descends into that desolate and terrifying place! What exactly are these monsters? Is the sudden outbreak of eternal slumber in the mortal world related to this place? Besides myself, who else has been chosen? There’s no time to think, death would come quietly!

Shen Ying, a foodaholic girl with no sense of direction from the modern world, came to another world through time travel. She had no money and couldn't get out of the spirit world. Incredibly talented as a martial arts master but also easily neglected, Shen Ying is like a bug in a video game. Shen Ying took Yi Qing, an upstanding swordsman, as her disciple although, at first, she only wanted him to cook for her. Yi Qing, a man of integrity and conscience, was defeated in a fight with a demon and fell into the yard of Shen Ying who later became his master through serendipity. However, Shen Ying and Yi Qing always talked past each other. Later they entered Xuantian Clan and with Shen Ying's simple explanations and his own imagination, Yi Qing gradually became an unbeatable swordsman in the world. This is a funny story about cultivation featuring two characters with strikingly different dispositions: an upright, gentle disciple and a hilarious but powerful master.

Surprisingly, he was taken back to the beginning of the crash and was reborn with the incredible Self-Destruction System. Now he earns points from his stupid acts, triggering self-destruction in order to be reborn. Each revival makes him stronger. Thus unfolds the story about how he starts over and makes his way to the top.

description.en: The modern world’s Xu Fei is a contemporary “average college student” with normal appearances, little money and barely any future. In the other world, where martial artists, cultivators, spell practitioners and personal forces wield all the power needed to take over the modern world. It cannot block more than a thousand of people nor shake the ground of ancient times, when medical care, food productions and political form, ect. were scarce. Let’s see how Xu Fei swept across the worlds and eventually became a tycoon of the two worlds!
description.pt-br: O Xu Fei do mundo moderno é um “estudante universitário médio” contemporâneo com aparência normal, pouco dinheiro e quase nenhum futuro. No outro mundo, onde artistas marciais, cultivadores, praticantes de feitiços e forças pessoais exercem todo o poder necessário para dominar o mundo moderno. Não pode bloquear mais de mil pessoas nem abalar o chão dos tempos antigos, quando cuidados médicos, produções de alimentos e forma política, etc. eram escassos. Vamos ver como Xu Fei varreu os mundos e acabou se tornando um magnata dos dois mundos!

description.en:
Nearly a decade ago, the mysterious race known as "The Entities" arrived in this world.

Initially, people were fearful towards the unknown lifeforms. However, upon discovering that their "moulting" could bring tremendous progress and benefits, people gradually began to accept them, bridging up the gap between different species. 

Yet, just as celebrations of peace and prosperity were underway, seeds of destruction began sow silently, threatening to dismantle the entire system…
description.pt-br:
Há quase uma década, a misteriosa raça conhecida como “Entidades” chegou a este mundo.

Inicialmente, as pessoas ficaram receosas com as formas de vida desconhecidas. No entanto, ao descobrirem que sua “pele” poderia trazer enormes progressos e benefícios, as pessoas começaram a aceitá-las gradualmente, diminuindo a distância entre as diferentes espécies. 

No entanto, quando as celebrações de paz e prosperidade estavam em andamento, sementes de destruição começaram a ser plantadas silenciosamente, ameaçando desmantelar todo o sistema...
description.zh-hk:
神秘的種族「異人」來到這個世界已快屆滿十年，起初人們對於未知生命都感到非常恐懼。

但在發現他們的「蛻皮」能帶來巨大的進步與利益之後，便逐漸地接納了他們，消弭了異種之間的隔閡。

然而，就在祝賀和平共榮的慶典舉行之際，將整個體制破壞殆盡的種子卻在悄然蔓延⋯。

description.en: I am Chen Ning, who transmigrated his way into a top sect in ancient China. Before the old matriarch passed away, they handed their position over along with some good tidings: “Grand elder Cang Yue is a planted agent sent by the dynasty to monitor the sect.” “The second elder is the saintess of the celestial sea holy land. She’s been lying low inside the sect as a planted agent since she was young, and is ready to act on the celestial sea holy land’s behalf at any time.” “The magnificent master enforcer is a demon spy who’s already spilled innumerable sect secrets.” “The sect number one is a beast-eared lass: a saboteur stationed in the sect by the beastkin. She’s watched the patriarch position menacingly, preparing to seize it to promote the beast agenda.” “Even my bodyguard is granddaughter to the bandit god. She follows the bandit god’s orders by pilfering sect treasures. How sly!” In short… everyone in the sect besides me is a planted agent.

By accidentally swallowing the "mint candy", he became the son-in-law of the Dragon King. The Dragon King is the big boss of the group, and his fiancee is a small pepper. The long tigers are watching, uh, this world is really dangerous…
description.pt-br: Ao engolir acidentalmente um "doce de menta", ele se tornou genro do Rei Dragão. O Rei Dragão é o chefão do grupo, e sua noiva é uma pimentinha. Os Grandes tigres estão observando, uh, este mundo é realmente perigoso…

Do you remember the taste of your first love? title.en: Monsters Die If They Are Killed

description.en: Su Zhou, who was born with exceptional physical attributes, encountered an evil cult during an oversea expedition with his childhood friend. In an attempt to rescue his childhood friend, he went into the enemy’s base alone. On the brink of death, he made a pact with a great entity and underwent a transcendent awakening in the new era of spiritual resurgence. In this universe that's in the twilight of destruction, one which is filled with monsters, demons, and formidable beings, evil entities are slayed in search of satisfying revenge. He won’t back down in fear, nor will he be bewildered. He doesn’t commit deliberate charity, nor does he seek justice. Su Zhou is the foe of all evils — “I’ll slaughter every evil soul that exists until no one dares to claim its name!” After all, just like that well-known cliche “People die if they are killed”, “Monsters die if they are killed."
description.es-la: Su Zhou se encontró con una organización de culto durante un viaje al extranjero, firmó un contrato con una gran existencia cuando estaba al borde de la vida o la muerte, y tuvo un despertar extraordinario, entrando en una nueva era. Véngate en este mundo de monstruos, demonios y grandes seres. No retrocederá con miedo ni desconcertado. Su Zhou es solo el enemigo del mal: «¡Mata todo el mal en este mundo hasta que nadie se atreva a llamarlo mal!» Al igual que la conocida tontería «Si matan a una persona, morirá» «Cuando un monstruo es asesinado, morirá».

description.en:
Amidst the chaos of a shattered life, Yu Zhou faces a crisis: discouragement that threatens her career as a writer. Everything seems to be falling apart — until an unexpected encounter changes her course. Xiang Wan, a mysterious and resilient woman who claims to have traveled back in time from Imperial China, appears in her life as a breath of hope.

With her ancestral courage and peculiar vision of the modern world, she helps Yu Zhou find the strength to move forward. However, fate has another surprise in store: Yu Zhou's literary work is adapted into an audio drama, and the protagonist chosen to give voice to the story is none other than Su Chang, her ex-girlfriend. The reunion of the two rekindles dormant memories and feelings, creating a delicate emotional triangle.

description.en: Troubled girl Ruan Xiaoli inexplicably binds herself to something claiming to be a system. It says, 'I’ll take you to three thousand worlds to be a villain, destroying the heavens and the earth, and stirring up blood and chaos.' Ruan Xiaoli finds this quite interesting and agrees. However… Hey, system, didn’t we agree that I’d just be a villain? Destroying the heavens and the earth and then getting killed by the world’s male lead should be enough. Why is it that every world’s male lead, instead of just killing me, seems to fall for this big villain? Hey, you, male lead, why are you following me around doing bad deeds? And you, am I the villain or are you? Ruan Xiaoli: I just want to be a proper villain and then be killed, achieving fame and success. I don’t want to fall in love; I just want to be killed by the world’s male lead. I’m wholeheartedly seeking death!

He found himself in the body of a young man named "Bai Zhu", and this body seemed... abnormal. Due to suspicious circumstances revolving around the disappearance of Jingmo's body, Jueming kept an eye on Jingmo, who desperately hid his true identity. With one of them hiding a secret and the other looking for the truth, the pair landed in the middle of a life-or-death struggle that came with being "Bai Zhu"...
description.zh: 有着魔修混血的京墨因一次魔气缠身，被哥哥决明杀死，睁眼后却重生到一名叫“白术”的少年身上，而这具身体……并不正常。他隐藏自己是京墨的身份，却被决明以找出弟弟尸身失踪真相为由留在身边。一个要隐藏身份，一个要寻找真相，两人循着“白术”这一身份被卷入一场生死之争中……

In order to become a normal person who can cry, Zuo Xiaoxia began to collect other people's tears. But who would've thought that she'd become entangled with the school hunk in the process?

Yue Zhishi and Song Yu are not blood related brothers, Yue Zhishi, who was fostered by the Song family since childhood, loves to cling to his older brother, Song Yu, who is three years older than him. However, Song Yu always deliberately maintains a distance. Song Yu, the brother who pretends to be indifferent, and Yue Zhishi, the brother who is a clingy little puppy. But what others don't know is that he understands his own heart, he choose to exercise self-control and maintain a distance because… Yue Zhishi is Song-Yu’s only allergen.

He was an obedient, gentle, and never willful lover. He kills people like flies, he is a schemer and an executioner. He is also a blade, a chess piece, an offering to the shrine of power. Everything ends in the Snow Plains, and yet everything also begins there.

My memory will forever remain in the year I took the college entrance exams." In the May of 2016, a high school senior at a small town's prestigious high school fell to her death and was ruled a suicide. Two years later, senior Yinzhe was welcomed into a new classroom on the top floor. Due to his unsatisfactory science grades in his junior year, he was forced to join the literature class. As the workload for supplemental courses slowly overwhelmed him, "hallucinations" started to occur... An unescapable nightmare-like high school life... Yet as now he looks back, he suddenly realized he could no longer feel the flow of time after the college entrance exams.

The first generation of Daoists was jealous of Zhang Daoling because he possessed a special treasure, the Supreme Ultimate Soul Stone. To capture this treasure, the immortals and gods devise a strategy to ambush and kill his beloved. In a fierce battle, Zhang Daoling detonates his primordial spirit and dies alongside the immortals and gods.
What’s going on, am I reincarnated in another world of swordsmanship and magic under the protection of Supreme Ultimate Soul Stone? I am the youngest son of the Blood Dragon family—— one of the Four Famous Generals of the Storm Kingdom.
How will the story of Zhang Daoling, who was once a Daoist, advance in this magical world?
description.it:
La prima generazione di taoisti era gelosa di Zhang Daoling perché possedeva un tesoro speciale, la Pietra Suprema dell'Anima Suprema. Per catturare questo tesoro, gli immortali e gli dei escogitano una strategia per tendere un'imboscata e uccidere la sua amata. In una feroce battaglia, Zhang Daoling fa esplodere il suo spirito primordiale e muore insieme agli immortali e agli dei.
Cosa sta succedendo, mi sto reincarnando in un altro mondo di spada e magia sotto la protezione della Supreme Ultimate Soul Stone? Sono il figlio più giovane della famiglia blood dragon, uno dei quattro famosi generali del Regno della Tempesta.
Come avanzerà la storia di Zhang Daoling, che una volta era un taoista, in questo mondo magico?
description.pt-br: O tesouro único da pedra da alma Taiji encantou imortais e deuses, e uma geração de taoísta Zhang Daoling foi criada para emboscar e matar sua amada. Zhang Daoling incendiou Yuanshen e todos os imortais e deuses, mas ele reencarnou em um mundo de espadas e magia graças à proteção da pedra da alma Taiji. Para onde Zhang Daoling, que está abraçando o taoísmo, viajará neste mundo mágico depois de se tornar um dos quatro generais do Reino da Tempestade – o filho mais novo da família Dragon Blood?

description.en:
Even if you're a social elite, you can never escape the nightmare of going on blind dates! This is a story of a workaholic man and woman who meet each other while trying to escape their respective blind dates.   
  
In order to fulfill the "Couple Contract", the fake couple must perform perfectly in various emergency situations. The contract clearly states that they are merely just "business partners", but why is there always this uncontrollable throbbing sensation inside?!   
  
Stay tuned to "We Are Not Familiar" and watch how awkward adults fall in love.

Vivian is a kind and beautiful girl. She comes to Dirtopia and opens a weapon store named "The Treasure House of God" in Yuqiang city. At the same time, she collects information and goes on adventures with her best friend Xiao Me. With that, a story of legends begin…

Being a doctor is like becoming the closest wall to heaven. Day after day, the lonely cold-faced beauty Xiao Yan and the cold-hearted Bai Shu, with a group of cute buddies in the emergency ICU, do their best to strengthen the wall closest to heaven and strive to bring those dying lives back to the path of life.

The Snow Wolves, a secret top-tier combat unit in the Z country, have maintained the only 100% win rate in the history of the group, and have exceptionally given the title of "Snow Wolves". After retiring from military service, Xu Wang is forced to become the fiance of the perfect CEO, Bai Feifei, who doesn't like him. Let's see how Xu Wang pushes through the world and the four seas, relying on the strongest single-armed force in history to start an extraordinary life!

One day, Fang Xiaowu accidentally got a super reading system. From then on, he can learn skills as long as he reads! By reading "West Chamber Futon" he learnt kung fu, read "Sun Tzu's Art of War" to grow his knowledge, he learnt how to tease girls by reading "Legend of Harem Zhen Huan Biography" ….. With system in my hand, I can have the world! ! ! I

Wang Sheng was unexpectedly reborn to the night before the sudden increase in spiritual energy on earth. "I am not going to be mediocre and looked down on by others like in my previous life." And so, he decided to go to Wudang to pay homage to his master from his previous life. And thus the daily life of the path to immortality begins...
description.id: Wang Sheng secara tak terduga terlahir kembali pada malam sebelum peningkatan mendadak energi spiritual di bumi. "Aku tidak akan menjadi biasa-biasa saja dan dipandang rendah oleh orang lain seperti di kehidupan ku yang sebelumnya."  Dia memutuskan untuk pergi ke Wudang untuk belajar seni bela diri dari salah satu master tertinggi di kehidupan sebelumnya. Dan dengan demikian kehidupan sehari-hari dari jalan menuju keabadian dimulai ...
